# JAH Fundamentals of Cryptography demo
# Record JAH-CRY-000024 — verifies its own structure and governing principle
record = {
    "id": "JAH-CRY-000024",
    "title": "Quantum Threats and Post-Quantum Crypto",
    "ladder_rank": 6,
    "edition": "signature",
}
principle = ("Hash avalanche", "flip 1 input bit \u2192 ~50% output bits change")
key_points = [
    "Quantum computers threaten RSA and Diffie-Hellman; lattice-based and hash-based schemes are the standardized replacements being deployed now.",
    "Hash avalanche: flip 1 input bit \u2192 ~50% output bits change \u2014 A secure hash scrambles every output bit when any input bit changes.",
    "Application: Building end-to-end encrypted messaging",
    "Ladder rank 6/6 (complex) \u2014 the most complex synthesis \u2014 full professional depth",
    "Capstone record of this ladder section",
]
assert isinstance(record["id"], str) and record["id"].startswith("JAH-CRY-"), "bad id prefix"
assert 1 <= record["ladder_rank"] <= 6, "ladder rank out of range"
assert record["edition"] in ("public", "signature"), "bad edition"
assert len(key_points) >= 4, "key points incomplete"
assert all(isinstance(k, str) and len(k) > 20 for k in key_points), "key point too thin"
print("Record:", record["id"], "-", record["title"])
print("Edition:", record["edition"], "| Ladder rank:", str(record["ladder_rank"]) + "/6")
print("Governing principle:", principle[0])
if principle[1]: print("  Relation:", principle[1])
for i, kp in enumerate(key_points, 1): print(str(i) + ". " + kp)
print("OK: JAH-CRY-000024 verified — full record, no drift")
